text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...So many people.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Racecourse is already packed to capacity.
Everyone's anticipation is focused on today's main race, the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course! After all,
Biwa Hayahide—the older sister of *the* Narita Brian—is running, you know?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how about this girl in that magazine over there?
She's petite and super cute!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Huh, Narita Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Hmm, it might be tough. She's just too small. If only she had a bit more build on her...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, the one named alongside Hayahide
as part of the top two is Winning Ticket!!
You should keep an eye on her all the way to the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Huh~, is that so~.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hah... bringing up build at this point?
And calling us the 'Big Two' on top of that...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Things like that really piss me off...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-kun.
The day of the Satsuki Sho has finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Both Ticket and Taishin are running in this race.
Which means...
choice_data_list: Looks like it's going to be a tough race.
Looks like it's going to be a tough race, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I agree. Without a doubt,
this is going to be a fiercely contested race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even so, this is the first leg of the Classic Triple Crown.
Losing is not an option.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "Can one become the strongest of the generation after tasting defeat here? The answer is no."
choice_data_list: Go out there and crush it!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's go seize some solid results!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Still, after going through the Asahi Hai FS,
I suppose I've grown accustomed to high-pressure situations.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Now then, time to head to the paddock—
(Tap, tap, tap...)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm? That is...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Taishin? For someone like her,
she's wearing quite a tense expression."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if your shoulders are too stiff, you won't be able to bring out your true strength.
Come, let us have a light chat...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (What's with her look just now...? It's like... she's a demon...)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the Umamusume are making
their entrance into the paddock one after another! Next is—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
! It's already my turn?
Ngh, I have to go...!
